# Ranga Mudunkotuwa

> Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in ASP.NET Core, React/Next.js, and production AI integrations (RAG, Gemini API, MCP), and G.C.E. Ordinary Level (O/L) ICT Tutor based in Sri Lanka.

## Summary
Ranga Mudunkotuwa (DMRB Mudunkotuwa) is a Bachelor of Information Technology (B.I.T.) undergraduate at the University of Colombo School of Computing (UCSC, 3.81 GPA) and a Cisco CCNA student at the University of Moratuwa. Alongside his industry experience as an Intern Software Developer at FACTn Software and Calcey Technologies, he teaches local G.C.E. Ordinary Level (O/L) Information & Communication Technology (ICT) for Grades 06–11 in Homagama and Habarakada.

## Software Engineering Experience
- **FACTn Software** — Intern Software Developer: Architected ChatN (multi-tenant AI API Gateway unifying OpenAI and Google Gemini APIs with Redis state tracking, Azure AI Search RAG pipelines, and MCP tool integration) and MyDrive (Flutter/React automotive platform with Gemini Live API voice chat).
- **Calcey Technologies** — Intern Software Developer: Built full-stack ASP.NET Core and React.js features and optimized PostgreSQL queries for Fresh Fitness Food (FFF).

## Selected Projects
- **Koa - Clothing**: Full-stack e-commerce platform using Next.js, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core Web API, CQRS/MediatR, PostgreSQL, and Azure Communication Service.
- **FaceTrack**: Facial recognition attendance system built with Python, Flask, OpenCV, and SQLite.
- **Wine Analytics Dashboard (NLP)**: Sentiment analysis and interactive visualization dashboard using Python, NLTK, Hugging Face Transformers, and Plotly Dash.
